rules: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto anywhere.
Headings MUST use tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.1em]).
Line height for headings MUST be tight (leading-none or leading-tight).
Line height for body text MUST be relaxed (leading-relaxed).

application_rules: The 'No Website' flag is the key business value. It MUST use bg-[#FACC15] (amber-400) with solid black text. Never make it subtle.
Use pure high-contrast borders for structural layout. Use 1px border-border.
Limit the use of primary colors to CTAs (Start Extraction, Export to Excel).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: GRID BORDERS (The Technical Look). Structure layout with pure 1px borders exposing the grid/skeleton.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp to extremely subtle rounding. Use rounded-sm (4px) maximum for inputs, buttons, and cards. No pills.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders for separation. Hover states can use shadow-sm.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-heavy screens. Use Solid Backgrounds to prevent visual refraction of data.

grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Left sidebar (w-64) with solid border-r. Include branding, navigation (Extractions, Schedules, History, Users), and User profile at bottom.
grids_and_layouts.header: Solid background with hard bottom border. Breadcrumb navigation and global actions (e.g., Export to Excel CTA) on the right.
grids_and_layouts.main_content: MODE B: High Density Grid. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_and_layouts.data_table: Takes up full width (col-span-full). Must support horizontal scrolling, sticky header, and pagination.
grids_and_layouts.filters: Sidebar or collapsible top panel above the table.

components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm edges. Explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white). Focus ring must be high contrast.
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but override radius to rounded-sm. Explicit focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900.
components.badges: Square badges. 'No Website' badge must be high-visibility amber. Other statuses (e.g., Active, Dissolved) use neutral or subtle color scales.
components.table: Compact. Use Shadcn table but reduce cell padding to py-2 px-3 to fit more data. Zebra striping (even:bg-slate-50) is recommended for legibility.
components.cards: Remove shadows. Use flat rectangular cards with border-border.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements (rows, buttons, links).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200. NO transition-all.
motion.loaders: Use minimal spinner or progressive linear loading bar for data dumps.

login_background.description: Minimal white wavy data texture. Use as a subtle background for the JWT Login screen. Overlay with bg-white/80 to ensure form readability.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially inside the data table, meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='login-submit-btn', data-testid='export-excel-btn', data-testid='no-website-filter-toggle'.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React .js project, NOT .tsx. All generated component files must be .js or .jsx.
Strictly follow the color tokens and typography set in these guidelines. Do NOT revert to Inter or Roboto.
Implement the 'No Website' flag with maximum visibility. It is the most critical data point for the user.
Use Lucide-react for all icons. Do not use emojis.
For the data table, ensure horizontal overflow is handled cleanly (overflow-x-auto) as companies data can be wide.
Ensure the layout prevents the sidebar from scrolling with the main content (fixed sidebar, scrollable main area).
Install required fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts or Fontsource.
Ensure Shadcn UI components are installed and customized as per the 'components' rules (e.g., removing default radii and shadows).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where specified.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
